statement_summary: Maintain a documented security program
Owner designated security and privacy lead
Yearly risk assessment using SP 800-30
Risk decision rules; High and Very High never accepted as they are
Yearly evaluation with outside challenge and testing
Public statements true when published; quarterly review
Written review before features that add a provider or use AI
Yearly policy review
Contractor and future workforce sanctions
Written, time-limited exceptions
No subscriber data to a provider without security terms and a DPA
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (FTC Start with Security 8); Customer DPA

statement_summary: Sub-processor list entry and 14 days' notice before data flows
Yearly review of sub-processor SOC 2 reports and customer controls
Security terms in contractor agreements
Individual accounts; no shared credentials
MFA on every administrator account; security keys where supported
Unique 14-character passphrases in a password manager
Super-admin for the owner only; named support role; quarterly account review
Secrets only in encrypted stores; secret scanning; 90-day rotation
Sealed emergency access kit held by the owner's attorney
Monthly log review; logs kept 12 months
Three-level data classification
Restricted data only in the platform and listed sub-processors
Synthetic data for development and testing
Full-disk encryption on every device
Exports by expiring links, not email attachments
Scrub personal data from error reports; 30-day retention
Deletion within 30 days of account closure; device disposal record
Security records kept at least 5 years
Changes only through the repository and CI; isolation tests
Monthly dependency triage; fix times; quarterly scan
Separate administrator browser profile; package checks
AI only after P10 assessment, DPA, list entry, and approval; human review of AI messages
Yearly awareness and secure coding training
Runbook, matrix, contacts, and templates kept outside company systems
Same-day incident log with discovery and confirmation times
Meet DPA and Florida notice deadlines; accurate notices
regulatory_driver: Customer DPA; Fla. Stat. 501.171(6)(a); N51-R01 (FTC Data Breach Response)

statement_summary: No ransom without counsel and an OFAC check
Backup copy outside the production account; photo versioning
regulatory_driver: N51-R01; website statement "automatic backups every day"
